summaryForAuthorized.text: On May 9, 2026 at 8:15 AM CDT, Truck 109 (driver Viktor Hale, trailer T-5321, load L-46210) was involved in a sideswipe collision during a lane change on I-294 NB MM 30 near Hillside, IL.
The tractor was not damaged; the trailer had left side panel and marker light damage.
No injuries were reported.
Our driver was cited (improper lane usage); post-accident tests were completed and documented.
The tractor remained drivable and is back in operation (4h 15m out of service); the trailer remained drivable and returned to service May 13 after 4.1 days out of service.
Cargo on load L-46210 was not damaged; delivered 4 hours late.
1 claim is linked: auto liability (closed).
Investigation complete (May 20): at fault, preventable.
Case closed Jul 2 by Rachel Moore.

summaryForAuthorized.text: On Sep 21, 2026 at 11:10 PM EDT, Truck 156 (driver Ruslan Tursunov, trailer T-5342, load L-47790) struck a fixed object on I-81 SB Exit 52 ramp near Carlisle, PA.
The tractor had minor right-front fairing damage; the trailer had a torn right side wall and axle damage.
No injuries were reported.

The tractor remained drivable and returned to service Sep 23 after 1.5 days out of service; the trailer was towed by Blue Mountain Heavy Recovery to Keystone Diesel & Collision, Carlisle and returned to service Oct 6 after 15 days out of service.
Cargo on load L-47790 was damaged (9 of 22 pallets); 13 pallets delivered Sep 24, 9 pallets rejected and sold for salvage.
3 claims are linked: physical damage (settled), cargo (negotiating), auto liability (awaiting documents) — the accident is closed while these claims continue.
Investigation complete (Oct 8): not at fault, non-preventable.
Case closed Oct 12 by Rachel Moore.

summaryForAuthorized.text: On Oct 2, 2026 at 3:45 PM CDT, Truck 118 (driver Andre Lewis, trailer T-5310, load L-47982) struck the rear of the vehicle ahead on I-80 EB near MM 127 (Houbolt Rd) near Channahon, IL.
The tractor has heavy front-end damage (bumper, hood, radiator) and could not be driven; the trailer was inspected and not damaged.
No injuries were reported.
Our driver was cited (following too closely); post-accident tests were completed and documented.
The tractor was towed by Lakeshore Towing & Recovery to Prairie State Truck & Body, Joliet and remains out of service (17 days so far).
Cargo on load L-47982 was not damaged; repowered with Truck 131 and delivered 1 day late.
2 claims are linked: physical damage (under review), auto liability (open).
Investigation is in progress; fault and preventability are not yet determined.
Next: Request ECM / engine data download from Prairie State — Fleet, Dmitri Volkov, due Oct 16.

summaryForAuthorized.text: On Oct 17, 2026 at 5:32 PM CDT, Truck 133 (driver Daniel Okafor, trailer T-5333, load L-48120) was involved in an intersection collision on US-30 WB at Broadway near Merrillville, IN.
The tractor has front bumper and hood damage but stayed drivable; the trailer was not damaged.
2 people treated away from the scene; our driver was not injured.
Medical detail: Sedan driver and passenger transported by EMS to a regional hospital; both conscious at the scene. Passenger reported neck pain. Admission status not confirmed.
The tractor remained drivable and returned to service Oct 18 after 17h 28m out of service.
Cargo on load L-48120 was not damaged; delivered 3 hours late.
1 claim is linked: auto liability (under review).
Investigation is in progress; fault and preventability are not yet determined.
